input.summary: Drop the three center targets, then repeat the saucer with the lit Spot arrows.

steps.text: Plunge the A lane. It is the only safe chance to collect A before an outlane.
Hit the three center drop targets. Each target lights one Spot arrow and adds bonus.
Watch which side has the lit Spot arrows. Shoot that top saucer.
modeNotes: Lit saucer: Scores 3,000 and adds one bonus step for each lit Spot arrow.

steps.text: Nudge a loose ball into a side chute when the opening is available. The chute feeds its saucer.
On the five-ball or conservative setup, the 10-point middle pop bumper moves the lit Spot side. On the three-ball setup, both sides may stay lit.
Complete A-B-C through natural top and return-lane feeds for 2x end-of-ball bonus.

fallback.title: Saucer scoring
fallback.when: Use this plan when the center drop-target rebounds are unsafe.

steps.text: Shoot the safer top saucer even when its Spot arrows are off.
Take the base 3,000 award.
Use natural A-B-C lanes and protect the end-of-ball bonus.

alternatives.title: Bonus first
alternatives.when: Use this plan when the top lanes and inlanes are feeding safely.

steps.text: Collect A-B-C for 2x end-of-ball bonus.
Use lit saucers to build base bonus to 15,000.
On the final ball, A-B-C combines with the automatic 2x for 4x bonus.
Use top switches and return lanes to raise base bonus to 15,000.
Complete A-B-C on the final ball for 4x.

techniques.name: Side-chute nudge
techniques.instruction: When a loose ball reaches a side-chute opening, nudge it into the chute. The chute feeds the top saucer.

cautions.issue: The three required drop targets can give hard rebounds.
cautions.response: Shoot them only from a controlled ball. Stop after all three are down and switch to the saucers.

cautions.issue: A saucer kickout can feed a flipper or carom into the bumpers.
cautions.response: Observe both kickouts. Repeat the saucer with the safer return when its Spot arrows are lit.

cautions.issue: A B or C post pass can continue into the outlane.
cautions.response: Do not force a post pass. Collect B and C from natural feeds when possible.

quickInfo.name: Long goal
quickInfo.summary: Use top switches and return lanes to raise base bonus to 15,000.

quickInfo.name: Safer fallback
quickInfo.summary: Saucer scoring: Use this plan when the center drop-target rebounds are unsafe.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Bronco or Mustang and three- or five-ball Spot-arrow behavior.
Check Extra Ball and Special conversion before chasing either award.
